Fires globs of slime that stick to and slows down enemies!|Store Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Slime Trooper''' is a starter support tower which fires globs of slime at enemies, slowing them down. It costs {{Coins|300}} to purchase. The '''Slime Trooper''' will fire a slime projectile at enemies at a decently slow firerate. When hit, they will receive the [[Slowed]] attribute, which slows them down and has slime drop from them, slowing them down by 15% at Level 0 and increasing at higher levels, reaching 22.5% at Level 4. [[Boss]] enemies are immune to any kind of slowdown applied by '''Slime Trooper'''. At Level 4, it will be able to hit multiple enemies at once as its slime projectiles now explode on impact and dealing [[Splash Damage]], though as it does not deal explosion damage some effects from that like [[Defense]] bypass, damage drop off or default lead detection are not present. The '''Slime Trooper's''' ability to slow down enemies is very similar to [[Toxic Gunner]], though they are both different effects and the latter has more potent slowdown and additional effects on top of slow. '''Slime Trooper''' is able to detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying|Flying]] enemies, making it useful across various gamemodes. As '''Slime Trooper''' cannot damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, it will require other towers to attack the them, such as [[Sniper]] or [[Shotgunner]]. The '''Slime Trooper''' is considered an early-game tower. It does great as starting defense, but towards late game, its damage is insufficient to deal with stronger enemies, therefore taking on a support role towards late game. The '''Slime Trooper''' is a support tower, and its main purpose is to slow down enemies, so it cannot defend against enemies by itself without the help of other towers, so it is best paired with high }} ==Skins== ''To see all the upgrades of a skin, see the [[/Gallery#Skin Upgrades|gallery]] page.'' {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:AnemoneSlimeTrooperIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Anemone}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Uncommon}} |- !Daily Store Cost |{{Coins|5,250}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Slime Trooper''' is a decent way to stall enemies, giving high damage towers like [[Ranger]] and [[Rocketeer]] more time to damage these enemies. **As its slowdown effect is unique, it can be used alongside other towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Tesla]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] without issue, allowing the effects to stack. *** Using these together with '''Slime Trooper''' can cause enemies to crawl at incredibly slow speeds, allowing more time for other towers to attack the enemies. However, this is not a reliable strategy unless a lot of high damage towers are brought. **[[Boss]] enemies will not receive the [[Slowed]] attribute, making them immune to the slowdown. **[[Firework Technician]] is also a good tower to pair with '''Slime Trooper''' as doing so grants '''Slime Trooper''' the ability to hit [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. The [[Medic]] can also be used to give it lead detection. ***Thanks to it being able to hit more enemies at Level 4, it can also generate multiple fireworks at once. *The '''Slime Trooper's''' targeting can be set to ''Random'' at Level 4 to maximize the splash damage and slowdown effect across a large group of enemies. **The '''Slime Trooper''' has a slow firerate, so this may not be very effective against swift enemies like [[Molten Mech]] or [[Yeti]]. This can be somewhat solved by pairing it up with cooldown decreasing towers like [[Commander]] or [[Medic]]. *The '''Slime Trooper''' possesses a rather small range, and thus careful placements is required to maximize this tower's effectiveness. ** At later levels, its range becomes much larger, thus being more forgiving in terms of placements. **Despite not having a placement limit, it is best to only put a few well-placed '''Slime Troopers''', mostly at choke points or near the front of the map to apply the effect on as many enemies as possible. *It is generally recommended not to focus on '''Slime Trooper''' solely for DPS, mainly due to its rather slow firerate, projectile travel time and middling damage output. It is better used as starting defense or stalling. *At Level 4, the '''Slime Trooper's''' [[Splash Damage]] has a small explosion radius, but has no limit to how many enemies can be hit, so '''Slime Trooper''' excels against dense hordes of slow-moving enemies rather than spread out groups of fast-moving enemies. **An example of this is [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode's Wave 35, where the huge crowds of enemies tightly squeezed together are perfect for the '''Slime Trooper''' to maximize its damage output and slowdown effect, although other towers are needed to help as the '''Slime Trooper''' cannot deal with such late-game enemy hordes alone. *The '''Slime Trooper''' can detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, making it quite useful for [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode or [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode where both enemy types are present. ** However, it can only detect flying enemies at Level 4+, which costs quite a lot to reach, making it somewhat unsuitable for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode due to how early flying enemies appear. **While it does create explosions, it is unable to damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. ==Trivia== *The '''Slime Trooper's''' concept bears resemblance to an unused tower concept of a Glue Gunner, a tower polled by BelowNatural in 2020.[[File:TDSGlueGunnerProof.png|280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1269528060296073217 *The '''Slime Trooper''' is the second [[Splash Damage]] tower to lack [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] detection, the first being [[Paintballer]]. *The '''Slime Trooper''' update thumbnail is located in the unreleased map [[Petulance Ground]]. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page. *'''8 May 2026''' - [[v1.90.0]] **'''Slime Trooper''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Slime Trooper''' cannot be bought. *'''8 May 2026''' - [[v1.90.0]]a **{{Bugfix}} '''Slime Trooper''' can now be bought. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Firerate decreased due to the [[Firerate Bug]] being fixed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 3.025 to 3. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|3.025 > 2.275|-0.75}} to {{Tooltip|3 > 2.25|-0.75}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|2.755 > 1.825|-0.475}} to {{Tooltip|2.25 > 1.8|-0.45}}. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.7]] **New skin: {{Color|Beach|Anemone}} **{{Bug}} {{Color|Beach|Anemone}} skin has no model, causing it to be impossible to place down. *'''3 July 2026''' - [[v2.2.0]] **{{Bugfix}} {{Color|Beach|Anemone}} skin now has a model. ==Notes== {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Ground]]
